say:1:1621150001:1.text: The magic jelly scheme has finally come to light, and Anzel has been taken in for questioning.
say:1:1621150001:1.source_cn: 魔力甜甜冻的骗局总算水落石出，安泽也已被带去调查。
say:1:1621150001:1.male: The magic jelly scheme has finally come to light, and Anzel has been taken in for questioning.

say:2:1621150002:1.text: You've done a huge favor to the Mithril Consortium this time.

say:4:1621150004:1.text: Holt Street only ever gets the same kind of customers, so I never thought trouble would start here. Turns out the Adamant Syndicate was working right under my nose.
say:4:1621150004:1.source_cn: 霍尔特商业街的客源很单一，我原以为出不了什么风浪，没想...
say:4:1621150004:1.male: Holt Street only ever gets the same kind of customers, so I never thought trouble would start here. Turns out the Adamant Syndicate was working right under my nose.
say:4:1621150004:1.female: Holt Street only ever gets the same kind of customers, so I never thought trouble would start here. Turns out the Adamant Syndicate was working right under my nose.

say:5:1621150005:1.text: Now it's clear—they've had people planted here from the start, running their whole operation while my oversight left them plenty of gaps to slip through...
say:5:1621150005:1.source_cn: 看来黑金商会的渗透从未停止，我的监管流程也还有不少漏洞……
say:5:1621150005:1.male: Now it's clear—they've had people planted here from the start, running their whole operation while my oversight left them plenty of gaps to slip through...
say:5:1621150005:1.female: Now it's clear—they've had people planted here from the start, running their whole operation while my oversight left them plenty of gaps to slip through...

say:6:1621150006:1.text: First the magic contracts, then the magic jelly... who knows what they'll pull next.
say:6:1621150006:1.source_cn: 先是魔力契约，接下来是魔力甜甜冻……也许他们接下来还会...
say:6:1621150006:1.male: First the magic contracts, then the magic jelly... who knows what they'll pull next.
say:6:1621150006:1.female: First the magic contracts, then the magic jelly... who knows what they'll pull next.

say:7:1621150007:1.text: Thanks for everything. I'll reinforce the regulations here. Hopefully this is the last trouble we see for a while...
say:7:1621150007:1.source_cn: 谢谢你的帮助，我会加强这里的监管。唉，真希望不要再闹出...
say:7:1621150007:1.male: Thanks for everything. I'll reinforce the regulations here. Hopefully this is the last trouble we see for a while...
say:7:1621150007:1.female: Thanks for everything. I'll reinforce the regulations here. Hopefully this is the last trouble we see for a while...

choice:3:0:1.text: Easy as pie. Just a small favor.

say:9:1621150003:1.text: Of course. I said I'd pay you, and I will!
say:9:1621150003:1.source_cn: 当然，我答应过你的决不食言！
